PhD in Geological Sciences
Advance your research expertise
The PhD in Geological Sciences at the University at Buffalo is tailored for individuals pursuing careers in academia or professions requiring advanced research skills. This program provides in-depth training in research methodology, combining coursework and original research to prepare you for leadership roles in earth sciences and related fields.
On this page:
Apply now
Program highlights
Opportunities to specialize while maintaining broad exposure to Earth science disciplines
Emphasis on independent research and scientific discovery
Advanced laboratory and field practice
Training aligned with careers in academia, industry and government research
Access to faculty expertise across multiple areas of Earth science
Why choose the PhD in Geological Sciences at UB?
Collaborate with globally recognized researchers in fields such as climate science, volcanology, and environmental geology.
Access advanced labs, field equipment, and computational tools to support your research.
Customize your coursework and research to match your interests and career aspirations.
Engage in groundbreaking projects addressing critical global challenges.
Program timeline
For BS Holders: Typically completed in four years.
For MS Holders: Typically completed in three years.
Other Science or Engineering Degrees: Applicants must have:
12 credits in advanced geology.
Completion of a Geology Field Camp.
These prerequisites can be completed during the doctoral program with guidance from your advisor. Additional prerequisites may be recommended based on your research focus.
What you'll learn
Design and conduct original research using field observations, experiments and modeling
Apply advanced scientific principles across geology, mathematics, chemistry and physics
Analyze geoscientific data using techniques such as numerical modeling and GIS
Develop and test hypotheses using the scientific method independently and collaboratively
Communicate complex scientific findings through written, oral and technical formats
Explore the course catalog
Career outcomes
Graduates of the PhD in Geological Sciences are prepared for:
Academic careers in research and teaching
Roles in government research organizations
Positions in the private sector related to environmental, energy or geoscience fields
Leadership roles in scientific and technical fields
